terms.title: Terms of Use and Store Policy
terms.intro: These Terms apply to the use of the abu alanas Fruits & Vegetables website, operated by mostafa ziadneh. The website is used for ordering fruits, vegetables, food products, and related products.

sections.heading: 1. General
body: The website is operated by mostafa ziadneh (the "Store"). Store name: abu alanas Fruits & Vegetables. Contact: 0543486348.
These terms apply to browsing, using the site, creating an account, joining the customer club, and placing orders.
Continued use of the site means you accept the current terms.
The store may update these terms from time to time. The current version published on the site is the binding version.

sections.heading: 2. Eligibility to Use the Website
body: You must be legally permitted to place orders and to enter into a transaction.
Where age-restricted products or services are relevant, use is intended for users aged 18 and over.
You must provide correct and up-to-date details, including name, phone number, delivery address and contact details.

sections.heading: 3. Account and guest checkout
body: You may place an order as a guest or with an account, where both options are offered.
If you create an account, you are responsible for keeping your login details secure.
The store may block or cancel an account or order in cases of misuse, fraud, false details, payment failure, or violation of these terms.

sections.heading: 4. Products
body: Product images are for illustration only.

The Store does not present itself as a kosher-certified store, and the website should not be relied upon as a source of kosher certification. Customers who require kosher information about a specific product should check the manufacturer's labeling on the product, if available, or contact the Store before placing an order.
Fresh produce may vary in size, color, shape, ripeness, weight and appearance.
For products sold by weight, the final supplied weight may reasonably differ from the estimated weight, and the final charge or refund reflects the actual supply where the system supports it.
Product availability may change, and the store is not obligated to supply products that are unavailable.

If a product is unavailable, the store may contact you and suggest a replacement. If you do not approve a replacement, the unavailable product will not be charged, or will be refunded if already charged.

sections.heading: 5. Prices and promotions
body: Prices include VAT where applicable.
Prices may change from time to time.
The binding price is the price shown at the relevant order confirmation / payment stage, unless there is an obvious error.
Promotions are valid only during the stated period or until stock runs out.
Promotions are not combined unless explicitly stated, and coupon or discount-code conditions may apply.

sections.heading: 6. Orders
body: Submitting an order does not always constitute final approval of the order.
An order is confirmed only after payment / order approval and store confirmation where relevant.
The store may cancel or change an order due to stock issues, delivery limitations, payment failure, incorrect details, technical error, suspected misuse, or legal/business reasons.
Computer and system records may serve as evidence of order actions and consents.

sections.heading: 7. Payment
body: The store does not store your full credit card number or CVV.
Where online payment is available, payments are handled by an external secure payment provider.
A payment failure may prevent completion of the order.
Only the payment methods actually supported by the store are offered at checkout.

sections.heading: 8. Service messages
body: The store may send you service and order messages related to your active orders.
Examples: order confirmation, payment confirmation, delivery updates, missing item updates, replacement coordination, cancellation/refund updates, and pickup/delivery coordination.
These are service messages and are not marketing messages.

sections.heading: 9. Prohibited use
body: You may not:
items: Use the site for any unlawful purpose.
Interfere with the operation of the website.
Scrape or crawl the site without permission.
Copy content or design without permission.
Place commercial resale or wholesale orders unless approved by the store.

sections.heading: 10. Intellectual property
body: The site design, content, logo, product texts, images, icons and software belong to the store or its licensors.
You may not copy, reproduce, distribute or make commercial use of them without written permission.

sections.heading: 11. Limitation of liability
body: The store works to keep the site accurate and available, but errors, downtime, stock differences and technical issues may occur.
To the extent permitted by law, the store is not responsible for indirect damages, except where liability cannot be excluded by law.

sections.heading: 12. Customer responsibility
body: Please check your order details before submitting.
Please be available to receive the delivery.
Please inspect your order after receiving it and report any issue promptly.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information {{storeName}} collects, how it is used, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
body: Depending on how you use the site, we may collect:
items: Payment status (but not your full credit card number or CVV).
Saved addresses, if you approved saving them.

sections.heading: 2. How we use your information
body: We use the information for purposes such as:
items: Saving your details for future orders, only if you approved.
Marketing, only if you explicitly approved.

sections.heading: 3. Sharing with third parties
body: We may share information, as needed, with:

sections.heading: 4. Your rights
body: Subject to applicable law, you may:
items: Request access to your personal data.
Request deletion of your saved delivery details.
Note that some data may be retained when required for legal, accounting or order records.

sections.heading: 5. Marketing
body: Marketing messages require separate, explicit consent.
You can unsubscribe from marketing at any time.
Unsubscribing from marketing does not stop service / order messages.

sections.heading: 6. Guest checkout
body: Guest order data is still stored to handle the order and to meet legal / accounting needs.
Guest checkout does not automatically mean joining the customer club or agreeing to marketing.

sections.heading: 7. Customer club
body: Joining the customer club is optional, unless otherwise required.
Customer-club data may be used for benefits, coupons, order history and personalized offers, only according to your consent settings.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.intro: This policy describes how deliveries from {{storeName}} work.

sections.heading: 1. Delivery areas and fees
body: Delivery is available to the areas listed at checkout.
Delivery fees and any minimum order are shown at checkout and may vary by area and order value.
Same-day delivery is offered only where store settings support it.
A pickup option is available only where the store offers it.

sections.heading: 2. Delivery times
body: Estimated delivery times are shown where relevant and are estimates only.
Delays may occur due to traffic, weather, holidays, high demand, security events, force majeure, stock issues, or operational issues.

sections.heading: 3. Your responsibilities
body: Please provide a correct address and phone number.
Please be available during the delivery window.
If you are not available, delivery may be delayed, cancelled, or require an additional delivery fee.
If the address you provided is wrong, you may bear extra costs.

sections.heading: 4. Leaving an order and fresh products
body: If you ask us to leave the order near the door, building, a neighbor or a public place, responsibility for the order after placement may pass to you, unless the store acted negligently.
Because produce is fresh, a delay after delivery or placement may affect quality, so please collect your order quickly.
Please inspect the order upon receipt.

cancellation.title: Cancellations, Returns and Refunds
cancellation.intro: Because we sell fresh and perishable products, this policy explains when an order can be cancelled and how issues are handled.

sections.heading: 1. Perishable products
body: Fresh fruits, vegetables and food products are perishable.
Cancellation is usually possible before picking, packing, preparing or delivery has started.
Once picking, packing, preparing or delivery has started, cancellation may not always be possible because the products are fresh and perishable.

sections.heading: 2. If something is wrong
body: If a product arrived damaged, missing, spoiled or incorrect, please contact the store as soon as possible — preferably within 24 hours — and include a photo where possible.
Depending on the case, the store may offer a replacement, store credit, a partial refund, or a full refund.

sections.heading: 3. Refunds
body: If you were charged for a product that was not supplied, you will be refunded or credited.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method where possible.
The store may ask for proof, a photo, or your order number.

sections.heading: 4. Limitations
body: If an issue was caused by incorrect details you provided, your unavailability, or your request to leave the order somewhere, the store may not be responsible for all costs.
This policy is subject to applicable law.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: We work to make the website accessible as much as possible according to Israeli Standard 5568 and WCAG 2.0 AA guidelines, according to the nature of the service. If you encounter an accessibility issue, please contact us and we will review and address it.

sections.heading: What we work on
body: As part of our ongoing effort, we work on:
items: Keyboard navigation across the main flows.
Reasonable color contrast for text and key elements.

sections.heading: Ongoing effort
body: Accessibility is an ongoing effort, and some parts may not yet be fully accessible.
This statement does not claim a formal accessibility audit has been completed.

sections.heading: Contact for accessibility
body: If you encounter a difficulty, please contact us at 0543486348 and we will work to review and address your request.

customerClub.title: Customer Club Terms
customerClub.intro: These terms govern membership in the {{storeName}} customer club.

sections.heading: 1. General
body: The customer club is operated by the store.
Joining the club is optional, unless store settings state otherwise.
The club terms may be updated, and the current version published on the site is the binding version.

sections.heading: 2. Joining the club
body: You may join through account registration, a checkout checkbox, or your account area, where implemented.
Required details may include name, phone, email, date of birth (if used), and order history.
We do not require unnecessary sensitive data.
Club membership is personal and cannot be transferred.

sections.heading: 3. Benefits
body: The store may offer benefits, coupons, discounts, birthday benefits, personalized offers, early access, or repeat-order benefits.
Benefits may change, expire, or be limited.
Benefits may be subject to stock, dates, minimum purchase, delivery area, or other conditions.
Discounts are not combined unless explicitly stated, and images in offers are for illustration only.

sections.heading: 4. Coupons and benefits
body: Coupons and benefits may be subject to conditions, including:
items: Coupons may not apply to delivery fees unless stated.
Lost, expired or used coupons may not be restored unless the store decides otherwise.
The store may cancel coupons in case of misuse.

sections.heading: 5. Marketing consent
body: Joining the customer club does not automatically mean consent to marketing.
Marketing consent is given separately through a clear marketing-consent checkbox.
Customer-club operational messages and marketing messages are kept separate.

sections.heading: 6. Leaving the club
body: You may request to leave the customer club at any time.
Leaving the club may cancel unused benefits.
Some order data may remain for legal, accounting or order records.
You may separately unsubscribe from marketing.

sections.heading: 7. Misuse
body: The store may block or cancel membership in cases of fraud, false details, misuse of coupons, violation of these terms, or harmful behavior.
